scripts.build: bun run --filter @casesync/api build && bun run --filter @casesync/web build
scripts.test: bun run --filter @casesync/api test && bun run --filter @casesync/web test
scripts.test:e2e: bun run seed:demo && bun run --filter @casesync/web test:e2e
scripts.test:e2e:smoke: bun run seed:demo && bun run --filter @casesync/web test:e2e:smoke
scripts.test:e2e:full: bun run seed:demo && bun run --filter @casesync/web test:e2e:full
scripts.test:e2e:mobile: bun run seed:demo && bun run --filter @casesync/web test:e2e:mobile
scripts.test:e2e:ui: bun run seed:demo && bun run --filter @casesync/web test:e2e:ui
scripts.test:e2e:cross-browser: bun run seed:demo && bun run --filter @casesync/web test:e2e:cross-browser
scripts.test:unit: bun run --filter @casesync/api test && bun run --filter @casesync/web test
scripts.test:integration: cd apps/api && RUN_INTEGRATION=1 bun test --isolate tests/integration
scripts.test:coverage: cd apps/api && RUN_INTEGRATION=1 bun test --isolate --coverage --coverage-reporter=lcov && cd ../.. && bun run scripts/check-coverage.ts
scripts.verify: bun run check:ci && bun run typecheck:api && bun run typecheck:web && bun run typecheck:web:tests && bun run test:unit && bun run build
